sources.reviewed_definition: -u filters unit messages; -n selects the recent event count. -k restricts kernel messages and implies current boot; -b -1 selects the preceding available boot. --no-pager bypasses paging. Logs are available records, not an assertion of fault or completeness.

sources.authority: Primary tool documentation published by vendor or official Ubuntu distribution
sources.reviewed_definition: grep reads files or pipeline stdin. -E selects extended regular expressions, | separates alternatives, and -i ignores case. Exit 0 means a selected line, 1 means no selected lines, and 2 means error. Redirecting stderr to /dev/null hides diagnostics; empty stdout alone does not distinguish no match from an error.

sources.authority: GNU gzip upstream manual published by the official Debian distribution
sources.reviewed_definition: zgrep decompresses the named compressed inputs and feeds them to grep, passing supported grep options through. The authored -E and -i are not in its unsupported-option list. Exit 0 identifies a match, 1 no match, and 2 trouble. A missing compressed history source is not evidence that no relevant event occurred.
sources.limit: Defines GNU gzip zgrep options, not which package version ran on the September Host.
